Checks subtraction, multiplication, addition and their failure order against an independent arbitrary-precision oracle. Three deliberately removed checks per language must be detected. C map/pipeline allocation failures and a deliberately omitted partial cleanup are checked separately. These derived control images are never timed and do not measure whole-process allocations.
